story: CTRL-16 — FULL phased pipeline GRID->NEURONS->BITS->CONNECTIONS->MEMORY (_full30 x4)
registered: 2026-09-25 (EDT), before any _full30 marker existed; s31337002 was in BITS gen 2/5
registered_by: Luiz: 'gate bar plus no larger TRUE keys'
rule: REPLACE the anchor iff >=3/4 columns favour _full30 (stable up, err down, steady down, alt down) on the mean paired HEADLINE delta vs _pipeN30 over seeds s31337002-s31337005, AND err delta <= +0.10 deg, AND the mean TRUE keys of the four _full30 winners <= the mean TRUE keys of the four _pipeN30 winners. Otherwise _pipeN30 stands; a tie goes to the simpler pipeline.
why_parsimony: The shared GRID->NEURONS prefix is deterministic: _full30 s2's NEURONS held-out is bit-identical to _pipeN30 s2's. Every difference is bought by BITS+CONNECTIONS, which cost 2-4x the wall time and grow genomes (BITS pool reached 3.26M cells vs the anchor winner's 0.69M). Matching the anchor at a larger footprint is a loss, not a tie.
comparator: _pipeN30 (the promoted anchor). The queue's _full30 - _hd30 read stays descriptive only.
rows: HEADLINE held-out, exactly as the promotion gate (experiments/promotion_gate_2009.json). Stage rows are reported alongside but do not decide.
caveats: n=4: every CI in the gate's own verdict straddled 0; a 3-of-4 column rule fires by chance ~31%. Say 'the rule fired', not 'the pipeline is better'.

_full30 s31337002 runs on the pre-fix evaluator batching (width 2); s3-s5 may run on branch eval-batch-pack. Parity tests show per-genome seeds and metrics are bit-identical across batch boundaries, so this does not break the pairing.
